# Belinda

## Overview

- **Age:** 13–15 years old across Volume 1 to Volume 4  <sub>[v1 c19 P68](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0068), [v1 c21 P48](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0048)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c19 P68](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0068)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive
- **Origin:** Brierley / St. Brendan's Island  <sub>[v1 c19 P68](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0068)</sub>
- **Role:** Domestic servant / housemaid  <sub>[v1 c19 P68](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0068), [v1 c21 P48](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0048)</sub>
- **Titles:** Belinda the Fourth  <sub>[v1 c19 P68](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0068)</sub>

## Appearance

Belinda is a petite girl with a freckled, broad face, a snub nose, and a wide mouth that stretches from ear to ear. She wears her long, fair hair braided into pigtails. At age fifteen, she styles her hair in a massive pompadour and dresses with oversized blue ribbon bows.

_Sources: [v1 c19 P34](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0034), [v1 c19 P78](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0078), [v1 c25 P42](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0042), [v1 c30 P27](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0027)_

## Personality

Belinda is cheerful, practical, and devoted to her employer, Miss Rosalind. Although she is prone to worry about domestic mishaps and catastrophic impossibilities, she works energetically and takes pride in her tasks. She enjoys romantic play-acting, holds a deep admiration for Nell, and maintains a broad, constant smile.

_Sources: [v1 c19 P52](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0052), [v1 c19 P68](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0068), [v1 c19 P87](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0087), [v1 c25 P42](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0042)_

## Traits

- Cheerfully hardworking and energetic  <sub>[v1 c19 P77](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0077), [v1 c25 P42](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0042)</sub>
- Prone to worry and catastrophizing  <sub>[v1 c19 P52](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0052), [v1 c25 P44](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0044)</sub>

## Abilities

- Domestic housework and cooking assistance  <sub>[v1 c19 P68](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0068), [v1 c25 P42](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0042)</sub>
- Imitating voices and theatrical sound effects for echoes  <sub>[v1 c19 P71](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0071), [v1 c19 P73](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0073)</sub>

## Goals

- To faithfully serve and care for Miss Rosalind Penrose  <sub>[v1 c19 P68](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0068), [v1 c21 P44](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0044)</sub>
- To move to Boston with Miss Rosalind after her marriage  <sub>[v1 c29 P10](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0010)</sub>

## History

Belinda began working as a maid for Miss Rosalind Penrose at Echo Cottage when she was thirteen years old. She readily accepted Miss Rosalind's quirk of calling her 'Belinda the Fourth' after her three older sisters who had previously held the post. She frequently helped Miss Rosalind with her romantic imaginings, such as blowing a tin horn and giggling to produce echoes in the forest for visitors like Nell and Isolde. When Stephen Stanhope returned to court Miss Rosalind, Belinda excitedly supported the romance. She helped prepare Echo Cottage for Miss Rosalind’s wedding, where she threw an old shoe that accidentally hit Mr. Wace. Following Miss Rosalind's marriage, Belinda planned to move to Boston with her and Mr. Stanhope.

_Sources: [v1 c19 P71](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0071), [v1 c19 P73](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0073), [v1 c19 P77](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0077), [v1 c19 P82](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0082), [v1 c19 P87](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0087), [v1 c19 P90](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0090), [v1 c25 P42](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0042), [v1 c25 P50](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0050), [v1 c29 P10](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0010), [v1 c30 P27](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0027)_

## Background by volume

- Her actual name is Leonora Bowman, but she is called 'Belinda the Fourth' because she is the fourth daughter from the Bowman family to work for Miss Rosalind.
- She went to work for Miss Rosalind at age thirteen in exchange for room, board, and clothes.
- Her elder sisters, Belinda the First, Julietta (Belinda the Second), and Evelina (Belinda the Third), all previously worked at Echo Cottage before moving to Boston upon turning sixteen.
